verdict.rationale: Together's OpenAI-compatibility docs say an existing OpenAI client can be pointed at Together by changing only the API key and base URL. The API reference documents a standard POST /v1/chat/completions endpoint, and tool calling, structured outputs and streaming follow the familiar chat-completions shape, which lets an agent swap providers without provider-specific code. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that switching mid-workflow works seamlessly, and documentation of any compatibility gaps or quirks versus the OpenAI spec.
